title: Reiver
author: Jay S.
desc:
A 12 week hybrid program built to preserve and grow muscle through a caloric cut while developing real strength on the big four lifts. 

Weeks 1–4 lock in technique and volume. 

Weeks 5–8 introduce planned heavy triples, a taste of powerlifting, on bench, squat, deadlift, and OHP. 

Weeks 9–11 peak into doubles and a final single, testing the strength you built without sacrificing the hypertrophy work that keeps you looking like a bodybuilder. 

Week 12 deloads so you come out the other side stronger, leaner, and intact.
